headline: Why is my money still blocked this close to retiring?
note:
FRAME: money — the strictest guard on the funnel. No amount, no date, no source, no financial advice, never blames her, never 'too late', never presumes she is broke.

🔴 Beat 4 says the money has not LANDED or not STAYED — never that she has none. Her own ad asserts the block, so restating it is her premise, not our claim.

⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE. The six beats never need it; naming an inheritance is the shortest path to the authorship ban.

FINDING (money guard): 'it was never her' — carried by beat 5a, 'the earning was never the problem'.

⚠ Worked as example 2 of inherited-shadow-cut.md. Written fresh here — the doc says copy the SHAPE, not the line.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see it, and your hand went to the worker of the three.
Look at his hands. Both are busy, and neither one is resting.
You asked why your money is still blocked this close to retiring. What catches me is how busy both those hands are.
And yet it hasn't landed, dear. And retiring keeps getting nearer.
The hold is steady, and it doesn't loosen. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing showed which was which, and you took the one held by a single rope.
Look at the rope. One ankle, and the rest of him hangs loose.
You asked why your money is still blocked this close to retiring. I keep looking at where that rope goes.
Still, it hasn't come through. And retiring is closer than it was.
Something is sitting between you and the money. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's doing the holding…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and yours was the one in full sun.
Look at the sky behind him. It's gold, and there's not a cloud in it.
You asked why your money is still blocked this close to retiring. Broad daylight, and a foot already up.
But it still hasn't landed. And you're the one asking why, this close in.
Something turns up right when it should land. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's there…
